prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent game skill icon, square, designed to remain crisp and immediately legible at 48x48 pixels in a compact action-game HUD. Primary request: Crystalfracture Pulse for Gu Pin, an original salvage-world signal technician. Single bold focal object: a short chunky fork-shaped industrial needle emitter angled from lower-left to upper-right, two sturdy copper prongs around one compressed luminous peacock-teal mineral-crystal pulse at the tips. Aged ivory ceramic grip/capacitor collar and dark umber body, very few mechanical pieces. One short energetic angular teal pulse wedge conveys electricity; no scattered sparks or busy particle cloud. Premium hand-painted stylized industrial fantasy illustration, strong silhouette, chunky readable planes, high local contrast, controlled highlights, slight three-quarter perspective, distinctly crafted original design. Palette: aged ivory #D2D1BB, peacock teal #3E8D8D with restrained brighter cyan core, dark umber #4B443D, warm copper accents. Clear solid object edge, simplified readable detail. Centered, full object and pulse contained inside 12% safe margins. Transparent alpha background, completely isolated. No environment, background color, floor, ground shadow, border, frame, circular UI badge, text, numbers, letters, logos or watermark. No character, no conventional magic wand, no ornate filigree, no recognizable existing game symbol. Do not add a square panel behind the icon.
